quotes.title: རྒྱན་སྣང་།
quotes.author: སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོ་
quotes.why: Haribhadra takes p3's sūtra citation as the brief statement (མདོར་བསྟན) of complete enlightenment, and reads it with བརྩོན་པར་བྱའོ where p3 has བསླབ་པར་བྱའོ.

quotes.title: རྒྱན་སྣང་།
quotes.author: སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོ་
quotes.why: Haribhadra glosses the sūtra's 'perfection of wisdom' as sarvākārajñatā — the Ornament's frame already applied to the sūtra's words.

quotes.title: རྒྱན་སྣང་།
quotes.author: སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོ་
quotes.why: The same phrase glossed as mārgajñatā in a different context, showing the gloss is positional rather than lexical.

quotes.title: རྒྱན་སྣང་།
quotes.author: སེང་གེ་བཟང་པོ་
quotes.why: Haribhadra's taxonomy of small, middling and great entrustment, which places p3's second citation precisely.
